purpose: Repair one coherent pre-outcome contract defect set in the H1 shared-backbone acquisition package. No source/universe/month/evidence/outcome rule may change.

immutable_research_scope.source: Binance USD-M monthly 1m klines on data.binance.vision

exact_repair_set.required_fix: Replace human-readable dataset/resource identifiers with a structured canonical DATASET_KEY containing every required field from sc001-shared-data-and-resource-coordination-v0.1.md; canonical serialization is UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and separators=(',',':'); RESOURCE_ID must equal lowercase SHA256 hex of those exact canonical bytes. The implementation and freeze must recompute and verify the same value rather than trust a literal.

Use shared cache identity rooted under SC001_DATA_ROOT/_raw_cache/binance/<RESOURCE_ID>/ for all frozen archive/checksum basenames, or an exactly equivalent deterministic layout that includes RESOURCE_ID and passes a self-test proving two tasks with the same DATASET_KEY map to the same physical path. No strategy-specific raw copy.

Extend row integrity without computing returns: parse all frozen columns; reject non-finite numeric values; require open/high/low/close > 0; require high >= max(open,close,low) and low <= min(open,close,high); require volume/quote/taker volumes >= 0; require trade count integer >= 0; require close_time == open_time + 59999 for 1m Binance klines; preserve exact 60s open-time sequence, 1,440 bars/day and fail-closed exact archive/day diagnostics.
For a new zero-byte .part, require HTTP 200 OR validate any HTTP 206 Content-Range begins at byte 0. Never silently accept a partial response beginning after byte 0.

required_test_additions: deterministic canonical DATASET_KEY serialization and RESOURCE_ID SHA256 fixture
shared cache path contains exact RESOURCE_ID and uses _raw_cache
negative volume and invalid trade-count rejection
terminal_rule: Apply only the exact coherent repair set, verify readback/diff and current main, then one TERMINAL RECEIPT with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false. Do not run tests in this task.
